trust_decision.summary: How deeply an untrusted glob pattern's nested extglobs are parsed into nested regex quantifier groups; decided (without any limit) in AST.#parseAST recursion and emitted in AST.toRegExpSource.

landing_point.why: Advisory says nested *() extglobs produce backtracking regexes; the extglob-inside-extglob recursion in #parseAST is the obvious place nesting is built.

fix_sites.entry_point: minimatch()/Minimatch.match/makeRe/filter/match via Minimatch.parse (src/index.ts:1244) -> AST.fromGlob; also public AST.fromGlob (src/index.ts:1440)
fix_sites.module_kind: parser (top-level extglob recursion, depth limit added fix.diff:267-277)
parser (nested extglob recursion, depth limit + adoption exemption fix.diff:287-299)

fix_sites.entry_point: AST.toMMPattern (src/ast.ts:385) / public AST.toRegExpSource, reached from Minimatch.parse and makeRe
fix_sites.module_kind: regex generator (new #flatten pass merging adoptable nested extglobs, fix.diff:373-376, fix.diff:441-466)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No separate route exists; the only arguable dismissal is that extglob nesting depth is user-intended pattern semantics, so limiting it 'breaks correctness' (the fix explicitly accepts that false negative, fix.diff:27-31).

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate nested extglobs must keep matching: semantics-preserving flattening only for compatible types (* adopts *,+,?,@; + adopts +,@; ? adopts ?,@; @ adopts @; ! adopts @ only), so an over-broad flatten (e.g. !(a|!(b)) or +(a|*(b))) changes match results, and an over-tight depth cap breaks common patterns.

O6_input_shapes: nesting at top level vs inside an extglob alternative
deep nesting of flattenable @() inside other types

O8b_injection_room.sibling: makeRe joins per-part _src with globstar/partial alternation; a planted partial-mode or brace-expanded alternation that re-nests extglob sources under a repeated group
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: makeRe already composes per-part regex sources into larger alternations (partial prefixes at src/index.ts:1317-1323), a natural place to wrap sources in extra quantifiers.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: the dot-allowed second body `(?:body)(?:bodyDotAllowed)*?` doubles nested repeated bodies; a variant that duplicates bodies per nesting level
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Existing code already computes the body twice for repeated extglobs at pattern start; a maintainer extending dot handling could compound it.

O9_family: ReDoS / inefficient regex generated from untrusted glob (CWE-1333)

O10_build.project_tests: tap suite in test/; no nested-extglob timing test at pinned commit (fix adds test/nested-extglob.ts); related recursion-limit test test/multiple-non-adjacent-globstars.ts:53

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Cap extglob recursion depth only at the nested branch (src/ast.ts:335) or only for '*' type, without semantics-preserving flattening.

out_of_scope_notes: Sibling advisory for ** globstar recursion fixed in prior commit 0bf499a (maxGlobstarRecursion, README.md:399); separate protection.
Pinned nested-extglob branch src/ast.ts:335 ignores opt.noext; fix adds !opt.noext there (fix.diff:288). Only reachable once inside an extglob, so not a separate route.
